# Eleven v4 MCP Voice Starter

Purpose: public, sanitized Node.js example for ElevenLabs Eleven v4 speech, stdio MCP, Telegram delivery, and local web playback.
Start: README.md
Agent rules: AGENTS.md
Voice creation: docs/voice-design.md
Architecture and output adapters: docs/architecture.md
Switching old TTS code to v4: docs/switch-v3-to-v4.md
Codex / ChatGPT Work / Chat: docs/openai-clients.md

Run: npm ci; copy .env.example to .env; fill your own secrets; npm test; npm start; npm run mcp.
Actual implementation: src/voice.mjs, src/gateway.mjs, src/mcp.mjs.
Do not infer that hosted ChatGPT Work can run this local stdio server or will automatically display an MCP audio block.
